xmldoc.short_description: Correct error by appending missing input arguments.

param_input_item.param_description: suggested arguments, specified as a string, a character vector, or a cell array of character vectors.

description.p: Use nelson.lang.correction.AppendArgumentsCorrection objects in functions that throw a MException object.
correction = nelson.lang.correction.AppendArgumentsCorrection(arguments) creates a correction that suggests appending input arguments to the function call that threw the MException object.
The read-only Arguments property contains the suggested arguments.
